notes: Rows use (instance_id, seed); repeat seeds and additional arms do not add independent tasks.
Pairs reference zero-based rows and contrasts; positive delta is candidate minus reference.
Full-denominator gains/losses count confirmed solutions; unknown/no-patch transitions remain separate.
Both-scored subsets do not replace full denominators; equal counts do not establish equivalence.
Official and external outcomes are separate; no combined Kaggle success-rate prediction.
Known token subtotals exclude unknown consumption; partial observations remain separate.
Task-slot sums include scoring/cleanup, not wall-clock or GPU time; missing agent time stays null.
Only the frozen manifest and sanitized result JSON are read; no run, grading or trajectory files.
